notes: Completed story set for Health Check Endpoint feature with full lifecycle coverage.

change_log.value: Added core health evaluation logic story

stories.title: Define Health Check Response Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define a standardized response schema for the /health endpoint including overall status (ok/degraded/down), timestamp, and dependency-level checks (e.g., MongoDB, external APIs if applicable). Ensure consistent JSON structure for monitoring systems.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/main.py; ASSUMPTION: No existing health schema defined; GAP required

stories.title: Implement Core Health Evaluation Logic
stories.description: Implement backend logic to evaluate system health including application liveness and critical dependency checks such as MongoDB connectivity using existing utilities. Return structured status aligned with defined schema.

stories.title: Expose /health Endpoint via FastAPI
stories.description: Add a /health endpoint to the FastAPI application in main.py that invokes the health evaluation logic and returns the standardized response. Ensure low latency and no authentication requirement for infrastructure probes.

stories.title: Health Check Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Create unit tests for health evaluation logic and integration tests for the /health endpoint validating response schema, success and failure scenarios (e.g., simulated DB outage), and HTTP status codes.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/tests/; ASSUMPTION: No existing health tests; GAP required

stories.title: Health Check Integration with Logging and Observability
stories.description: Integrate /health endpoint with debug logging to record health check invocations and dependency status outcomes (success/failure) for operational visibility without exposing sensitive details.

per_feature.mitigation: Limit checks to lightweight dependency pings and avoid external API calls
